The Postmark from Next Friday

Elias found the first envelope under his door on a Tuesday, though it was postmarked for the following Friday, November 27, 2026.

The ink is still wet. Inside, a handwritten note thanked him for leaving the apartment so clean for the next occupant.

He wasn't moving, yet another letter arrived dated December 1st, describing the quiet passing of the previous tenant in the kitchen.

The ink is still wet. He tried to flee, but the deadbolt wouldn't turn, as if the apartment had already evicted his physical form.

He saw a final envelope slide through the crack, reporting that the unit was now vacant and ready for viewing.

The ink is still wet. Elias looked down and realized he could see the floorboards right through his own feet.

He was no longer a resident, just a lingering coldness, finally fading into the monochrome fog of the room.
